content: {"investigate": [{"tool": "sql", "query": "SELECT p.id, p.order_id, p.created_at, o.id, o.status, o.created_at as order_created FROM payments p LEFT JOIN orders o ON p.order_id = o.id WHERE p.status = 'captured' AND (o.id IS NULL OR o.status != 'confirmed') ORDER BY p.created_at LIMIT 10", "why": "Check if orders exist but are not confirmed, and compare payment vs order creation times"}], "hypotheses": [], "summary": "Investigating timing relationship between payment capture and order confirmation"}
